name: Shadow Hills Mastering Compressor
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: values are positions, read through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

The discrete stage's ratio, attack and recovery (stepped) carry to any compressor; the optical and discrete threshold and gain knobs are Shadow Hills positions and carry between the Class A and Mastering versions only. Channel 1 is written; in Stereo mode it should drive both.

Flood (the top ratio) is Shadow Hills-only and isn't carried; Dual recovery carries as auto release. Hardwire Bypass stands in for in/out. Transformer, side-chain and meter settings come back as you left them.
